description: This file contains PHP source code for generating various dashboards and charts in the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions for retrieving data from the database, generating different types of graphs (horizontal, vertical, pie), caching images, and rendering dashboard components specific to the vtiger CRM modules such as Accounts, Potentials, Contacts, Leads, Quotes, etc.

methods.name: get_account_name
methods.description: Retrieves the account name for a given vtiger_account ID from the database.

methods.name: module_Chart_HomePageDashboard
methods.description: Generates dashboard data for the home page, including counts of various modules for a specific user.

methods.name: module_Chart
methods.description: Fetches data and generates parameters for rendering different types of module-specific charts.

methods.name: save_image_map
methods.description: Saves an image map to a specified filename on disk.

methods.name: get_graph_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves a graph (horizontal, vertical, pie) for display, utilizing cached images if available, and generates new graphs if not.

methods.name: get_graph
methods.description: Creates detailed chart data and renders graphs based on specified parameters and data query results.

methods.name: get_graph_homepg
methods.description: Generates graphs for the dashboard's home page, including selection based on chart type and caching logic.
